request.style: English, Male solo voice, gritty and soulful, electric guitar, upright bass, Hammond organ, brushed drums, melancholic and reverent, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David reigned over all the land
Justice and righteousness in his hand
He secured the kingdom's peace
And placed his servants in their place

[Verse]
Joab over the army stood
Jehoshaphat recorded the word
Zadok and Ahimelech served
Priests to the Lord they preserved

[Chorus]
Seraiah was secretary
Writing the king's decree
In the register of the great
His name is set in the text

[Verse]
Benaiah over the Kerethites
And David's sons were priests
An organized house of rule
Where every duty is fulfilled

[Chorus]
Seraiah was secretary
Writing the king's decree
In the register of the great
His name is set in the text

[Bridge]
Shavsha in Chronicles appears
The same scribe, different name
Documenting the royal word
In the stability of the Lord

[Outro]
Seraiah was secretary
Faithful in his station
